coprimality.scope: for primitive a,b with both odd and a+b divisible by 3

interpretation.eisenstein: B is the norm of a+b*omega in Z[omega]
interpretation.gaussian: C is the norm of a+i*b in Z[i]
interpretation.research_reduction: a collision requires simultaneous ninth-power norm conditions in both UFDs

primitive_local_conditions.mod_2: a and b are odd; v_2(C)=1; B and D are odd
primitive_local_conditions.mod_3: 3 does not divide ab, a+b is divisible by 3, v_3(B)=1, and 3 does not divide CD

scope_limitation: The descent is a necessary condition for a collision; nonexistence of the simultaneous ninth-power solutions is not yet proved here.

verification.mod_2: complete enumeration of odd residue classes modulo 8
verification.mod_3: complete enumeration of admissible residue classes modulo 9
